title: 'Supertanker' strikes mine in Hormuz, losing two million barrels of oil
paragraphs: Four oil tankers have hit mines and caught fire while travelling through the Strait of Hormuz.
One was a "supertanker" carrying more than two million barrels of oil.
Oman said it had rescued 25 crew members from a tanker attacked in the Strait, without confirming whether it was one of those which hit a mine.
